messages:
alice.releases: Heads-up — planning a scheduled window to unpin runtime v2.14 for llm-llama3q canary. Target window: 2024-10-04 02:00 UTC. deploy-bot will run preflight checks. Need compatibility sign-off with SDK >= 1.5.0 before global rollout. Please ack or flag blockers.

deploy-bot: preflight run started (check-suite #4512). Quick summary:
```
3 failed / 12 total
- KV cache eviction mismatch (KVE-42)
- Token ordering regression in long-seq (TOK-11)
- Quantized conv mismatch on bfloat models (QCM-07)
```
Full logs: https://ci.redwood/4512

ben.runtime: Those 3 look SDK-related. SDK 1.5.0 changed kvcache serialization. Likely mismatch between v2 proto on SDK and runtime default. I'll triage but we should avoid global unpin until we understand blast radius.

carla.sdk: Confirming: SDK 1.5.0 shipped KV proto v2 + deterministic token ordering tweaks. We added a compatibility shim but it requires the runtime to opt in (`--kvcache-compat=v2`) or SDK to fall back. I can cut a 1.5.1 patch to re-enable legacy serialization by default if we want a quick rollback path.

jamie.devex: Recommend holding the global unpin. Two asks: 1) clearly document the `--kvcache-compat` flag and sample rollout steps in release notes; 2) add a one-liner for customers to force fallback to runtime v2.13 if they hit KVE-42.

matt.ops: If we hold, can we do a staggered unpin? e.g., enable v2.14 for low-traffic canaries (eu, us-east) and keep us-west/asia on v2.13 until fixes land. Also: can deploy-bot be configured to auto-fallback to v2.13 for requests that raise KVE-42?

alice.releases: Proposed plan: postpone global unpin. Staggered approach: 1) enable v2.14 for EU + us-east canaries only; 2) add runtime fallback rule to route to v2.13 on KVE-42; 3) cut SDK 1.5.1 (carla) with legacy-default shim; 4) publish release notes + runbook (jamie). Need final ack by EOD (18:00 UTC).

ben.runtime: I can add the fallback routing logic: detect KVE-42 at request time and route to pinned v2.13 cluster. Will open PR against routing service (ETA: 3h).

carla.sdk: I'll cut SDK 1.5.1 today with an opt-out flag (`--disable-legacy-kvcache`) and push docs. If we need faster mitigation I can publish a patched wheel to the internal bucket and tag the release engineer.

deploy-bot: Manual override: scheduled window moved to 2024-10-04 02:00 UTC by alice.releases. Preflight requeued (check-suite #4513).

jamie.devex: :thumbsup: I'll draft release notes + sample `--kvcache-compat` usage, add a migration snippet, and create a short FAQ for support. Will ping eng-ps for review.

alice.releases: Action items summarized: ben — PR for fallback routing; carla — SDK 1.5.1 patch + internal wheel; jamie — release notes & runbook. If no major objections by 18:00 UTC, we'll proceed with the staggered canary unpin. Thanks all.

matt.ops: ack
